scripts.build: prisma migrate deploy && prisma generate && next build
scripts.setup: prisma generate && prisma db push && tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.git:publish: node -e "const {execSync}=require('node:child_process'); const status = execSync('git status --porcelain',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim(); if(status){ execSync('git add .',{stdio:'inherit'}); try { execSync('git diff --cached --quiet',{stdio:'inherit'}); } catch { execSync('git commit -m \"chore: deploy update\"',{stdio:'inherit'}); } } else { console.log('No file changes to commit.'); } execSync('git push origin main',{stdio:'inherit'});"
scripts.deploy:all: npm run git:publish && npm run deploy:vercel
